title: AuthorizedPlanReceipt
description: Proof that some authority approved one exact plan. It is produced by the approver and names the digest it approved, so approval stops being a field inside the document under approval — a plan cannot raise its own authorisation by rewriting a string and re-digesting itself. It is not a signature: anyone who can write this file can claim an approval. What it buys is that the claim is a separate artifact with a named actor, a time, and a digest it is bound to, which a reader can check against the plan in front of them.

planDigest.description: The digest of the exact planCore this approval covers.

authority.description: OWNER outranks HERMES. A HERMES approval cannot cover a plan the compiler raised to OWNER.

sourceReceipt.description: Where the approval came from, when it came from somewhere that issues its own receipts.

supersededBy.description: The digest of the approval that replaced this one. Present means this approval is spent.
